title: Fastest way to get to malenia ?
comments:
The shortest legit way would be:

Defeat 2 bosses, activate 1 great rune, get eaten below Raya Lucaria to get to volcano manor and beat the abductor virgins to access the plateau (or take the tunnel and beat the magma wyrm), beat draconic tree sentinel, Gold Godfrey, morgott, get secret lift pieces, solve puzzle, reach haligtree.

---

The shortest "legit" way would be:

- waygate in the tower in the South Beach, takes you to platform above the capital. Use a taunter's tongue until an enemy spawns below and activates the elevator to reach you. You can now use the elevator to enter the capital. (Unless it's blocked by the door to the alternate round table, I can't remember if that would definitely be in your way.)

- Beat Gold Godfrey and Morgott

- horse jump off the mountaintop of giants to land in the stake of Marika zone at the minor erdtree in the snowfield

- do the puzzle and warp to haligtree

- outside prayer room jump down the elevator shaft in the tower mid way through the level. If you land on the button you'll activate the elevator straight down to her.

---

The less legitimate way would be warping from that place above the capital to Perfumer's grotto and exiting quickly so that the game starts you in the capital when you return to it. Then follow the same steps.

---

The least legitimate is get the horse, teach it to fly like the speedrunners do, carefully climb the mountaintop below the fire giant, ride over to the snowfield, do the puzzle, get to haligtree.

---
I don't mind fighting the bosses, I just want to get there asap, I just thought it can be done quickly since speedrunners beat the game in like 9 minutes.

You can skip the dectus lift using the academy abductor or using the cave/ladders at the far north of the river coming off of liurnia. Haligtree though... don't think there's any way to skip that medallion. But its only 2 locations you need to go to.

You can skip the Grand Lift of Dectus but honestly, getting the two medallion pieces isn't any longer than going through the entirety of the cave since you can run right through Fort Faroth and Fort Haight for the most part. 

Everything else is required. 

Defeat two shardbearers to unlock the capital, defeat Morgott to unlock the area leading to the Mountaintops of the Giants, get both halves of the secret medallion.

If it’s “too much work” and not a “not enough time” scenario. Just cheese your way to her with low effort. Beat Renalla and Godrick, get the Dectus halves by just sprinting to them, it’s not like they’re behind a boss. Cheese Draconic Sentinel by sneaking behind him and using Poison Mist, Goad Golden Godfrey into doing his jumping axe throw move over and over and just punishing and evading, cheese Omen Margot with the shackle exploit, get the last haligtree half by shooting status arrows/bolts at the boss guarding it from outside his arena, look up a video on how to do the Consecrated Snowfields evergoal without even having to look at the Black Knife or Archers, then just sprint to Loretta and beat her with a summon/spirit (I used Swarm of Flies spam and a mimic) Then you can just run to Melania. Will still take a couple hours, but we’re talking about a boss locked behind an area you aren’t supposed to get access to until the last 20% or so of an over 100 hour experience.
